name: Issue 2 happy path
steps: Teach the multi-message Context Dump and completion signal.
Receipt-only acknowledge each dump message until dump complete.
Ask recommended decisions one at a time.
Present an approved Alignment Gate with the Execution Scope Contract and observable Acceptance Criteria.
Keep unmapped hardening as a follow-up and require explicit approval for scope expansion.
Deliver English Final Prompt, Review Translation, and Fresh Run instructions.
